name: ai-model-selector

frames.best_why: Picker is open above the field with all models, effort set to Max and its hint shown; other frames use lower stops.

tagline: Model picker that opens upward with an effort slider that reshapes per model.
summary: A pill in an AI composer showing the current model and effort. Pressing it opens a panel above with a radio list of models and a segmented effort track whose stops change with the chosen model, plus a line explaining the trade-off.
appearance: A rounded composer card with a line of prompt text, a small pill showing the model name, a tiny signal-bar glyph and an effort word, and paperclip and send circles beside it. The open panel above is a white rounded card with model rows and a segmented effort track.
behaviour: Clicking the pill opens the panel upward with a spring; picking a model checks it and reshapes the effort stops, keeping a similar relative height. The track can be dragged, clicked or arrowed, and the hint below swaps as the level changes.
demo_content: A postcode refactor prompt with Atlas Pro 3, Atlas 3, Atlas Lite 3 and Nova Code 2.
search_phrases: choose an ai model from a menu
model picker in a chat composer
use_when: An AI composer needs one compact control for both the model and how hard it should think.
avoid_when: The panel is 320px wide and opens upward, so it needs room above; models and effort levels come from you.
customise: Pass a models array with names, descriptions, icons and effort levels plus controlled value and onChange; the panel styling, spring and effort carry-over need a source edit.
weight_why: A small pill and a panel of a few rows; animation runs only while opening or dragging.

a11y.note: Everything works from the keyboard and is labelled; the track's stop labels are hidden from screen readers, so its value text carries the meaning.

issues: The effort labels inside the track are hidden from screen readers, leaving only the slider value.
polish_why: Tidy, well-labelled selector with a clever per-model effort track and a compact panel.
